title: Faversham Stirling Memorial
location_name: St Mary of Charity Church, Faversham, Kent
crew_summary: Crew — details not recorded in source
memorial_details: Inscribed processional cross to F/S P.E. Hebbes MiD inside St Mary of Charity Church, Faversham, Kent.
narrative: Stirling EE956 of 1661 Heavy Conversion Unit departed Winthorpe at 2324 on 17 May 1944 on a night cross-country navigation exercise. The loss is recorded in Chorley's Bomber Command Losses Vol. 8. Flight Sergeant P.E. Hebbes, who was Mentioned in Dispatches, has a memorial in the form of an inscribed processional cross at St Mary of Charity Church in Faversham, Kent.
notes: Winthorpe is in Newark, Nottinghamshire — a regional connection to the register's existing Winthorpe-area records.
